lines.en: I drift; my feet never touch ground.

lines.zh: 机械关节走起来没有声音。
lines.en: My joints make no sound.

lines.zh: 这具身体走多少路都不累。
lines.en: This body never tires of walking.
I scan every window.

lines.zh: 人造的躯壳比原来好用多了。
lines.en: The artificial shell suits me better.
The grass bends away as I pass.

lines.zh: 我在测量每个活物的气。
lines.en: I measure the ki of every living thing.

lines.zh: 地毯式地走过去，一个都不放过。
lines.en: I sweep across, sparing none.
These eyes see through walls.
I log targets as I move.
I walk with my palms turned down.

lines.zh: 表皮没有温度，也不出汗。
lines.en: My skin has no warmth and no sweat.

lines.zh: 我站着，像一台待机的机器。
lines.en: I stand like an idle machine.
My energy is still trickling back.

lines.zh: 我在听这个星球的杂音。
lines.en: I listen to this world's noise.

lines.zh: 我把手指一根根弯下来。
lines.en: I flex my fingers one by one.
The seams of the work still show.

lines.zh: 我已经不记得饿的感觉。
lines.en: I no longer remember hunger.
I hold my ki at my chest.
With no enemy, I calculate.
Wind passes me by. I ignore it.

lines.zh: 这些人的命真好，还很暖。
lines.en: These people are lucky — still warm.
I look up. The sky is blue.

lines.zh: 我在等一个值得动手的目标。
lines.en: I wait for a target worth the effort.
My shadow does not rise and fall.
Your ki is clean. A waste.
I have scanned you.
Hold still. Let me finish reading.
Your heart rate is elevated.

lines.zh: 你这具身体，还能再改造。
lines.en: That body of yours could be improved.
I was human once.
Your bone structure is unremarkable.

lines.zh: 我不需要理由就能动手。
lines.en: I need no reason to act.
You carry energy residue.
Your smile is ugly.

lines.zh: 我给你一个逃走的机会。
lines.en: I am giving you one chance to flee.
I know what you are thinking.
I never waste a specimen.
Your breathing rate changed.
I do not blink.
Your stance is steady. Trained.
The injury is your left leg. Correct?
The shell is scratched. Function intact.
I shift back and recalculate.
Pain is only data.
That blow landed on a seam.

lines.zh: 修复需要时间，我不缺时间。
lines.en: Repair takes time. Time I have.
I raise my head; my eyes still glow.
The damage is negligible.
I press the crack shut.
Food is useless to me.
You test me with that?
I kill without eating.

lines.zh: 这具身体不消耗那种东西。
lines.en: This body does not burn that.
I take it only to study.
Taste is forgotten.
You are stalling.
On the table. Do not approach.
You misjudge me.
Take it back.
You have no weight.

lines.zh: 我挡了一下，只用了半边身。
lines.en: I block with half my frame.
Move. My shell is hard.

lines.zh: 你撞在金属上，听见了吗？
lines.en: You struck metal. Heard it?
That impulse does not move me.
I put a hand out and shift you aside.

lines.zh: 别贴这么近，我讨厌温度。
lines.en: Not so close. I dislike warmth.
I take half a step and reset.
Your balance is decent.
Again. Let me see your limit.

lines.zh: 这具身体没有这种功能。
lines.en: This body lacks that function.
I passed that stage long ago.
You waste your time.
I turn my head.
Emotion is a design flaw.
I require only energy.
I have no heartbeat to offer.
Do not say such things.

lines.zh: 我记得那个人，但很久了。
lines.en: I remember someone. Long ago.
Save it.
I do not bend to pick things up.
A pull of ki brings it.
This component merits study.
Specimen secured.
I draw it into my palm.
A fingerprint will remain. No matter.
This metal interests me.
I store it in my chest compartment.
Everything left behind is a clue.

lines.zh: 谁碰过它，我都能看出来。
lines.en: I can tell who touched it.
Targeting complete.
I need no proximity to strike.
You have no options left.
I begin drawing your energy.
Stand. Do not waste my time.

lines.zh: 你的动作我看得一清二楚。
lines.en: I see every motion.
This strike is predicted.
Ki is gathered in my palm.
When I raise my hand, you should know.
You are on record.
Do not think to ambush me.
I am one step ahead.
This is a matter of efficiency.

lines.zh: 你的生命读数是满的，可惜。
lines.en: Your life reading is full. A shame.
I analyze each of your steps.
Your weight leans left.

lines.zh: 我从你的肌肉读出意图。
lines.en: I read intent in your muscles.
A ki blast forms between my fingers.
The more you run, the more your ki scatters.
I need not chase. I wait.
How much does your armor cover?
The beam needs a moment to charge.
You have shown me your back.

lines.zh: 预判完成，我在你下一步。
lines.en: Prediction done. I am at your next step.
That range requires no movement.
I keep calculating the impact point.

lines.zh: 人造人的能量，我吸得动。
lines.en: Android energy, I can drain it.
Moving will kill you faster.
I hold your ki in place.
You have one choice left.
Good. Just like that.
My palm edge cuts down without a sound.
I seize your energy.

lines.zh: 这一掌贴着你的护甲滑进去。
lines.en: My palm slides inside your plate.

lines.zh: 我连打三下，落点都在同一处。
lines.en: Three strikes, one point.
I absorb your blow.
My fist is light, but it pierces armor.
A beam fires from my palm.
I close in, denying you range.
Your bones creak in my grip.
That one I predicted.
I slip aside and add a palm strike.
Your bracer cracked.
Half output was enough.
Still have strength?
I have you by the collar.

lines.zh: 落地声很轻，是我的脚步。
lines.en: The soft landing is mine.
Scanning begins.
This place smells fresh.
I have awaited this day.
The shell is repaired.
Look — I am no longer human.
I have come to collect specimens.
I prepared this move for a long time.
Hold. Let me finish reading you.

lines.zh: 这片地方很安静，我喜欢。
lines.en: Quiet here. I like it.
I descend from the sky.
The wake of my ki has not settled.
I clasp my hands behind my back.
Your weapons are obsolete.
My energy reading is climbing.
High heat softens my shell.

lines.zh: 落地时我砸出个坑，膝盖没弯。
lines.en: I crater the ground; my knees do not bend.

lines.zh: 水进了关节，动作开始迟缓。
lines.en: Water in my joints slows me.

lines.zh: 冲击波把我的护甲掀开一层。
lines.en: The blast peels a layer off my plating.

lines.zh: 弹头卡在我肩上，我取出来。
lines.en: The round lodges in my shoulder. I remove it.
Magic interferes with my core.

lines.zh: 我不进食，但能量会耗尽。
lines.en: I do not eat, but energy drains.
Lightning overloads me; I briefly shut down.

lines.zh: 这里没有坐标，我无法定位。
lines.en: No coordinates here. I cannot orient.
